up: Retrieve activity data for compounds tested against the target '11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase 1' (ChEMBL ID: CHEMBL4235). The query must join activities with assays, target_dictionary, compound_structures, compound_records, and docs. Filters: 1) Target organism must be 'Homo sapiens'. 2) Only include compounds that have a valid canonical SMILES in compound_structures. 3) Only include rows where the source document has a valid PubMed ID or DOI (i.e., docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL). Output columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary), canonical_smiles, compound_key (from compound_records), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description (from assays), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment (from activities), target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary), target_name (pref_name from target_dictionary), and organism (from target_dictionary).
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key AS compound_key, COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, a.standard_type AS standard_type, a.standard_relation AS standard_relation, a.standard_value AS standard_value, a.standard_units AS standard_units, a.activity_comment AS activity_comment, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS organism FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4235' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL) AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
